definitions.explanation: At all times; without exception. More formal than いつも.

examples.japanese: {常|つね}に⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's important to always make an effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常|つね}に⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}されている→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧。
examples.english: He is always calm and is trusted by everyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常|つね}に⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れている→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧。
examples.english: This store constantly introduces new products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常|つね}に⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}しています→行動：02728_koudou⟧。
examples.english: She always acts with the customer's best interests as her top priority.

notes:
{常|つね}に means "always" or "at all times" with a formal, written tone. It emphasizes consistency and permanence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always (casual, everyday — the most common choice)
- {常|つね}に: always (formal, written — implies principle or permanent state)
- ⟦{絶|た}えず→絶えず：15260_taezu⟧: constantly, incessantly (emphasizes continuous action without break)
- ⟦{常々|つねづね}→常々：27906_tsunezune⟧: habitually, always (often with opinions or thoughts one regularly holds)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {常|つね}に⟦{意識|いしき}する→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧: to always be aware of
- {常|つね}に⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: to always be calm
- {常|つね}に⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧: to always make an effort

POSITION:
Placed before the verb or adjective it modifies.

REGISTER:
Formal and written. In everyday speech, ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ is more natural. {常|つね}に appears in essays, speeches, business writing, and proverbs.
